//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Automatic Doors -> Config

Enable Automatic Doors.//: Whether Automatic Doors is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

doorOpenTime.//: The time in ms the door should stay open. min: 0, max: 10,000

shouldOpenIronDoors.//: When enabled, iron doors will also be opened automatically.

preventOpeningOnSneak.//: When enabled, doors won't be opened automatically when the player is sneaking.
